'''Agent Essor''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War|Civil War]], she tasked a Republic spacer to recover data spikes which was important to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] efforts.
